explanation: The battle's own article places it before the war and inside its causation in one sentence: "This battle is an antecedent of the Arauco War." It is the first fighting between Spanish conquistadors and the Mapuche, ten years before the war this atlas dates from 1546 — which is why Wikidata's P361 filing under the war was refused here and this edge written instead. Precondition-of and not caused: an antecedent is what the article claims, and a battle at the confluence of the Ñuble and the Itata does not bring about a war that starts a decade later; it is what the war was already under way from.
